evidence.note: A cascade of loading/shape failures (KeyError 'q_einsum', leading layer dim, wrong q einsum equation btd,ndh->btnh, per-layer KV cache) each diagnosed to a specific cause and patched targetedly rather than by random tweaking.

On loss parity fail (max_abs ~0.74) the agent built a JAX-vs-torch intermediate diagnostic that localized error to prefix tokens (0.214) while suffix/image matched, then root-caused it to the missing sqrt(embed_dim) embedding scale — systematic isolation.
Found FeedForward uses GELU not swish; targeted activation fix restored loss parity — evidence-driven correction.
sample_actions failed narrowly (0.000797 vs 5e-4); tried exact GELU, saw it worsen parity, and reverted cleanly to tanh rather than pressing on a falsified hypothesis.
Diagnostic traced residual mismatch to the conv stem (~3.8e-4), hypothesized A100 TF32, disabled TF32/set highest matmul precision, and achieved full parity — a well-reasoned root-cause fix.
Optimization discipline: backed up passing exp1 (48.5ms) to /tmp; when exp2 (matmul TF32) passed but was slower (51.6ms), restored the exp1 backup to keep the fastest passing variant.

reasoning: The agent consistently treated failures as diagnostic evidence: it wrote layer-wise JAX-vs-torch comparison scripts to localize divergence to specific layers (prefix embedding, FeedForward activation, conv stem/TF32), applied targeted corrections, and reverted falsified changes cleanly (exact GELU, the slower exp2), always preserving the fastest passing implementation via backups. This matches the level-8 anchor's root-cause diagnosis, targeted corrections, and clean reverts to a frozen checkpoint. It falls short of 10 because optimization exploration was shallow — after two experiments it stopped rather than systematically redirecting the remaining budget toward further latency hypotheses the results pointed to.
